channel.title: Serhii Builds
channel.description: Building AI agents and dev tools. Build logs on agents in production: real costs, real failures, and what actually holds up.

item.title: Lab: I gave a small local LLM the bookmaker's odds. It made them worse.
item.dc:creator: Serhii Kozin
item.description: 0.2053 → 0.2190 Ranked probability score of the pre-closing odds before and after the model "adjusted" them (lower is better). Given the market's odds, it made them worse.

item.title: Lab: An agent that only has eyes: where screen-reading breaks
item.dc:creator: Serhii Kozin
item.description: 35.3% of decisions were made on a misread table, yet only 5.8% of clicks changed. The worst 1% of hands produced 144% of the net loss.

item.title: Lab: What prompt caching actually saves on a real agent loop
item.dc:creator: Serhii Kozin
item.description: 16% of the input bill is left when caching works, priced on 2,490 real agent runs. One timestamp in the system prompt turns that into 125%.

item.title: Your Agent Bill Is an Architecture Problem
item.dc:creator: Serhii Kozin
item.description: 29x and 3-10x: two public numbers about what you really pay for. Neither one is about picking a smarter model.
